senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. glass-lump, unshaped and prepared for casting into vessels.
units: Sabb. 154ᵇ בבלוסא Ar. (ed. בכולסא, read as Rashi a. Ms. בבולסא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) what is meant here are glass lumps (which may be broken without loss).—Pl. בּוּלְסַיָּיא, בּוּלְסִין crystals or glass vessels.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:4:12">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite> top <he>אילין ב׳</he> those glass vessels (what is the law concerning their division among heirs)? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:4:12">Ib.</cite> <he>חכים … בולסיין סגין</he> (corr. acc.) thou art known to have plenty of glass vessels.
